edges.reason: Base constructor is executed by the deployer msg.sender.
Deployer msg.sender is stored into governance, granting a privileged role.
governance state variable is read to authorize SetGovernance.
require(msg.sender == governance) gates SetGovernance.
SetGovernance writes the governance state variable.
governance state variable is read to authorize SetController.
require(msg.sender == governance) gates SetController.
SetController writes the controller state variable.
controller is read for authorization and as transfer recipient.
require(msg.sender == controller) gates withdraw(IERC20).
controller is read to authorize withdraw(uint256).
require(msg.sender == controller) gates withdraw(uint256).
controller is read to authorize withdrawAll().
require(msg.sender == controller) gates withdrawAll().
Controller(controller).vaults resolves fwant and frecv addresses.
SetRecv assigns the recv state variable.
SetRecv assigns fwant from controller vault lookup.
SetRecv assigns frecv from controller vault lookup.
REN constructor invokes SetRecv.
Constructor reads the curve constant address.
Constructor writes the index state variable.
index parameter is stored into the index state variable.
controller parameter flows through the base constructor into controller state.
wBTC instance constructor invokes the REN parent constructor.
index selects which slot of the amounts vector receives the want amount.
amount is placed into the liquidity vector for add_liquidity.
local vec is passed as the amounts array to Curve add_liquidity.
DepositToken performs an external Curve add_liquidity call.
curve constant is used as the callee for liquidity operations.
DepositToken performs safeApprove ERC20 calls on want and curve.
WithdrawToken calls Curve remove_liquidity and exchange.
WithdrawToken performs safeApprove ERC20 calls on recv and coins.
amount parameter drives remove_liquidity burn amount.
local vec is passed to Curve remove_liquidity.
coin balance _bal is exchanged back to the want index.
resolved ERC20 coin address is used for balance and approve.
index controls loop skip and the exchange destination coin.
GetPriceE18 calls curve get_virtual_price.
deposit invokes DepositToken to convert want.
want balance is forwarded to DepositToken.
deposit invokes Vault(frecv).deposit.
recv balance amount is deposited into the vault.
recv balance triggers safeApprove on the frecv vault.
frecv address is the vault target for the deposit call.
withdraw calls GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant to convert want to recv.
_aw is the requested withdrawal amount driving the logic.
_aw participates in sub/mul/div arithmetic chain.
_w is subtracted from _aw using SafeMath.
price divides the shortfall amount _ar.
_ar is used to compute vault share amount _af.
_r is subtracted from _ar in SafeMath.
frecv priceE18 is read to derive _af.
_af caps the vault share amount against _f.
min(_f,_af) is passed to Vault(frecv).withdraw.
WithdrawToken is invoked with min(_r,_ar) of recv.
min(_aw,_w) is transferred out with safeTransfer.
fwant is the recipient of the transferred want.
withdraw finishes with an ERC20 transfer to fwant.
withdrawAll withdraws all frecv vault shares.
withdrawAll converts recv back via WithdrawToken.
final want balance is transferred to fwant.
fwant is the transfer recipient inside withdrawAll.
want balance accumulator in balanceOf.
recv balance accumulator in balanceOf.
frecv balance scaled by priceE18 and divided by 1e18.
frecv address read to query vault price and balance.
recv address read to query recv balance.
want address read to query want balance.
balanceOf calls GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant for recv valuation.
constructor reads ICurveFiREN(curve).coins(_index) to derive want.
_index parameter indexes the curve coin lookup.
_asset parameter identifies the token to sweep.
asset balance is computed and returned to the controller.
asset balance is moved with safeTransfer to the controller.
Vault.withdraw external call transfers control before balances settle, allowing re-entry into withdraw.
Vault.withdraw external call inside withdrawAll can re-enter before the final transfer.
Curve liquidity/exchange external call can re-enter WithdrawToken.
ERC20 transfer to fwant at the end of withdrawAll can re-enter the strategy.
ERC20 safeTransfer of the swept asset can re-enter withdraw(IERC20).
